description:
An accomplished and certified Career Counsellor with a rich and diverse experience of guiding 1000+ students since 2020. Expert in identifying the best-fit courses for students by analysing their abilities, interests, personality traits, and emerging opportunities in India and Abroad like (Europe (UK, Netherland, Ireland, Italy), Asia (Japan, Singapore, Hongkong, South Korea ) Australia & NZ and USA& Canada. My counselling is deeply personalized, based on a student’s aptitude, personality, and interests, helping them discover best-fit academic and career paths.
I offer structured guidance based on psychometric test across different student stages:
Psychometics Test and Career Counselling
Psychometric Tests in multiple languages (Hindi, Marathi, Gujarati, English etc ) for Indian Board and International Board like IGCSE, IB etc
🔹 Class 5 – 7: Career Early Navigator (Launched 14 Nov 2025)
🔹 Class 8–10: Stream selection for senior school (5 dimensions test)
🔹 Class 11–12: Exam, Program and college Selection( 6 dimensions test)
🔹 Engineering Stream Selection and College sections (As per score MHTCET/JEE)
🔹 Abroad College-bound students: Application strategy, country/course/college selection, essay guidance and End to End Guidance.
